---
title: "Pre-course instructions"
toc: true
toc-location: right
---

To participate in this workshop, you do not need to prepare anything or install
any software. 

You will work in small groups. A laptop or tablet is useful if you would like to
type your group's README, but pen and paper work just as well.

## Thinking about a project of your own (optional)

In the last part of the workshop there is time for discussion and for feedback
on your own documentation. If you would like to take part, think about a dataset
or a piece of code that you have made or work with. It does not need to be
finished. If you already have a README for it, you can bring it along.
